name: Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente
body: One-year HSTS with preload, nosniff, a strict Referrer-Policy, and framing limited to its origin. But robots.txt names no sitemap and /sitemap.xml answers 404, so crawlers find pages by links alone.
lesson: Publish a sitemap.xml of the pages you want found and name it in robots.txt with one Sitemap: line.
summary: www.ambientebogota.gov.co scores 79 out of 100 (C). 0 checks fail now, 26 are at risk, and 17 pass. Fix first: 20 pages have no meta description.

fix.title: 20 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /transparencia, /atencion-y-servicios-a-la-ciudadania/tramites-y-servicios, /atencion-y-servicios-a-la-ciudadania/canales-de-atencion-y-solicitud-de-cita and 16 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 18 structured data items miss a property Google expects
fix.evidence: /transparencia Article lacks author, datePublished, /atencion-y-servicios-a-la-ciudadania/canales-de-atencion-y-solicitud-de-cita Article lacks author, datePublished, /atencion-y-servicios-a-la-ciudadania/defensor-del-ciudadano Article lacks author,…
fix.fix: Fill the missing properties so the item qualifies for rich results.

fix.title: 20 pages have no canonical link
fix.evidence: /, /transparencia, /atencion-y-servicios-a-la-ciudadania/tramites-y-servicios, /atencion-y-servicios-a-la-ciudadania/canales-de-atencion-y-solicitud-de-cita and 16 more. Without it, tracking parameters and trailing slashes can split ranking signals.
fix.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="…"> with the page's own https URL.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Analytics 4 appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
HSTS is sent with a long max-age
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 661 ms
